issues.detail: 6 video model(s) publish pricing that cannot be normalised to USD per output second: ['black-forest-labs/flux-video-upscale', 'bytedance/seedance-2.0-mini', 'bytedance/seedance-2.5', 'bytedance/seedance-2.0', 'bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast', 'bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro']. Their catalogue rate stays blank; value ranking still uses their observed benchmark cost.
